verified_context: Required behavior is explicit primary versus secondary groups in Then, visible primary buttons and overflow secondary controls with existing confirmations.

The compiler can already prepare forms for operations outside a row. It separately enforces row ownership for edit/delete/row action. Shared card and generated-view group rendering is underway; shared page has a title header and evaluated child list. Slot-based overlays and collection rows have distinct layouts.

Page support with form children reuses protected input preparation and dialog presentation for Create; it adds heading layout tests. Omitting page leaves the new feature confined to record cards. Supporting overlays and collection rows as well requires additional layout semantics.

host_set.instructions: Which scope best balances the requested reusable action hierarchy, known owner APIs and finite acceptance?

criteria.A: Ship record card and view hosts only; retain canonical row-control children and fail other placements.
criteria.B: Ship page/card/view hosts and canonical form plus record-control children, preserving scope checks and adding page-header defaults; reject other containers.
criteria.C: Ship groups in all relevant page/card/view/overlay/collection containers with new placement contracts for each.
